Private Function L(w As Object) As String
    L = w.Caption & "#" & w.WindowNumber & "#" & w.Index
End Function

Public Function RowWorkbook(wb As Workbook, ByVal name As String, ByVal folder As String, ByVal before As Long, ByVal books As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, n As String, w As Object, r As Variant, i As Long
    On Error GoTo failed
    Select Case name
    Case "captions"
        wb.NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows.Count & "|" & Application.Windows.Count - before & "|" & L(wb.Windows(1)) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(2)) & "|" & L(ActiveWindow) & "|" & wb.Name
    Case "returned"
        Set w = wb.NewWindow
        s = TypeName(w) & "|" & L(w) & "|" & (w Is ActiveWindow) & "|" & TypeName(w.Parent) & "|" & w.Parent.Name
    Case "from_window"
        Set w = wb.Windows(1).NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows.Count & "|" & L(w)
    Case "three"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.NewWindow
        s = L(wb.Windows(1)) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(2)) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(3))
    Case "own_caption"
        wb.Windows(1).Caption = "Mine"
        wb.NewWindow
        s = L(wb.Windows(1)) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(2))
    Case "caption_set_after"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(2).Caption = "Mine"
        s = L(wb.Windows(1)) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(2)) & "|" & wb.Name
    Case "lookup"
        wb.NewWindow
        n = wb.Name
        s = Application.Windows(n & "  -  1").WindowNumber & "|" & wb.Windows(n & "  -  2").WindowNumber
    Case "lookup_plain"
        wb.NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows(wb.Name).WindowNumber
    Case "lookup_after_close"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(1).Close
        s = wb.Windows(wb.Name).WindowNumber
    Case "sheet_copied"
        wb.Sheets("B").Activate
        wb.NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows(1).ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & wb.Windows(2).ActiveSheet.Name
    Case "sheet_own"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Sheets("B").Activate
        s = wb.Windows(1).ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & wb.Windows(2).ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & wb.ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & L(ActiveWindow)
    Case "sheet_after_switch"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Sheets("B").Activate
        wb.Windows(2).Activate
        s = wb.ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & L(ActiveWindow) & "|" & wb.Windows(1).ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & wb.Windows(2).ActiveSheet.Name
    Case "selection_copied"
        wb.Sheets("A").Range("C3").Select
        wb.NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows(1).RangeSelection.Address & "|" & wb.Windows(2).RangeSelection.Address
    Case "selection_own"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Sheets("A").Range("D4").Select
        s = wb.Windows(1).RangeSelection.Address & "|" & wb.Windows(2).RangeSelection.Address & "|" & Selection.Address & "|" & ActiveCell.Address
    Case "zoom_copied"
        wb.Windows(1).Zoom = 150
        wb.NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows(1).Zoom & "|" & wb.Windows(2).Zoom
    Case "zoom_own"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(1).Zoom = 80
        s = wb.Windows(1).Zoom & "|" & wb.Windows(2).Zoom
    Case "gridlines_own"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(1).DisplayGridlines = False
        s = wb.Windows(1).DisplayGridlines & "|" & wb.Windows(2).DisplayGridlines
    Case "headings_copied"
        wb.Windows(1).DisplayHeadings = False
        wb.NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows(1).DisplayHeadings & "|" & wb.Windows(2).DisplayHeadings
    Case "tabs_own"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(1).DisplayWorkbookTabs = False
        s = wb.Windows(1).DisplayWorkbookTabs & "|" & wb.Windows(2).DisplayWorkbookTabs
    Case "freeze_copied"
        wb.Sheets("A").Range("B2").Select
        ActiveWindow.FreezePanes = True
        wb.NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows(1).FreezePanes & "|" & wb.Windows(2).FreezePanes & "|" & wb.Windows(2).Panes.Count
    Case "views_of_sheet"
        wb.NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows(1).SheetViews.Count & "|" & wb.Windows(2).SheetViews.Count
    Case "close_front"
        wb.NewWindow
        r = wb.Windows(1).Close
        s = r & "|" & wb.Windows.Count & "|" & L(wb.Windows(1)) & "|" & Workbooks.Count - books
    Case "close_back"
        wb.NewWindow
        r = wb.Windows(2).Close
        s = r & "|" & wb.Windows.Count & "|" & L(wb.Windows(1))
    Case "close_middle"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(2).Close
        s = L(wb.Windows(1)) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(2))
    Case "close_number_one"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.NewWindow
        For i = 1 To 3
        If wb.Windows(i).WindowNumber = 1 Then Exit For
        Next
        wb.Windows(i).Close
        s = L(wb.Windows(1)) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(2))
    Case "number_after_close"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(2).Close
        Set w = wb.NewWindow
        s = L(w) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(2)) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(3))
    Case "held_after_close"
        Set w = wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(2).Close
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(1).Close
        s = w.WindowNumber
    Case "last_closes_book"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(1).Close
        wb.Windows(1).Close
        s = Workbooks.Count - books
    Case "workbook_close"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Close False
        s = Workbooks.Count - books & "|" & Application.Windows.Count - before
    Case "activate_next"
        wb.NewWindow
        r = ActiveWindow.ActivateNext
        s = r & "|" & L(ActiveWindow) & "|" & L(Application.Windows(1))
    Case "activate_previous"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.NewWindow
        r = ActiveWindow.ActivatePrevious
        s = r & "|" & L(ActiveWindow) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(1))
    Case "hidden_copied"
        wb.Windows(1).Visible = False
        Set w = wb.NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows.Count & "|" & w.Visible & "|" & L(w)
    Case "hidden_other"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Windows(2).Visible = False
        s = wb.Windows(1).Visible & "|" & wb.Windows(2).Visible & "|" & L(ActiveWindow)
    Case "protected"
        wb.Protect Windows:=True
        wb.NewWindow
        s = wb.Windows.Count
    Case "protect_with_two"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Protect Windows:=True
        s = wb.Windows.Count & "|" & wb.ProtectWindows
    Case "argument"
        wb.NewWindow 1
        s = wb.Windows.Count
    Case "rename_by_save"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\Named.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        s = L(wb.Windows(1)) & "|" & L(wb.Windows(2)) & "|" & wb.Windows.Count
    Case "saved_reopen"
        wb.Sheets("B").Activate
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Sheets("A").Activate
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\Two.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\Two.xlsx", 0)
        s = wb.Windows.Count & "|" & L(wb.Windows(1)) & "|" & wb.Windows(1).ActiveSheet.Name
    Case "saved_then_second_reopen"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\Two.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        wb.Close False
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\Two.xlsx", 0)
        s = wb.Windows.Count & "|" & L(wb.Windows(wb.Windows.Count)) & "|" & wb.Windows(wb.Windows.Count).ActiveSheet.Name
    Case "new_sheet_elsewhere"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Sheets.Add
        s = wb.Windows(1).ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & wb.Windows(2).ActiveSheet.Name
    Case "sheet_deleted"
        wb.NewWindow
        wb.Sheets("B").Activate
        wb.Sheets("B").Delete
        s = wb.Windows(1).ActiveSheet.Name & "|" & wb.Windows(2).ActiveSheet.Name
    End Select
    RowWorkbook = s
    Exit Function
failed:
    RowWorkbook = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Public Function InModel(ByVal name As String, ByVal binding As String, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, before As Long, books As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    before = Application.Windows.Count
    books = Workbooks.Count
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.Worksheets(1).Name = "A"
    wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(1)).Name = "B"
    wb.Worksheets("A").Activate
    If binding = "Workbook" Then
        InModel = RowWorkbook(wb, name, folder, before, books)
    Else
        InModel = RowObject(wb, name, folder, before, books)
    End If
End Function
